mapper.insert: INSERT INTO executing_event (title, event_serial_number, operator_id, reg_date, from_dt, to_dt, place_name, place_addr) VALUES(#{title}, #{eventSerialNumber}, #{operatorId}, #{regDate}, #{fromDt}, #{toDt}, #{placeName}, #{placeAddr});
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM executing_event ee INNER JOIN event e ON ee.id = e.id WHERE ee.id = #{id};
